items.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011
items.q: Matthew, the youngest... I’ve traveled with him all the time... they’re all good musicians.

ctx.x: And your children gravitated. The cellist, is Michael?
Matthew said when asked about making a living as a musician he said, “I didn’t know there was any other way.”
